messages:
rachel: Heads-up: during our year-end pricing experiment rollback, a batch job reapplied the YEAREND2026 promo to several accounts that had already received a manual promo. Customer HelioWorks was overbilled on INV-2026-1921 by $980. Invoice: https://invoices.redwood.dev/INV-2026-1921
maria: Ugh. Can you paste the reconciliation extract and the customer's billing contact? Need to confirm whether its system+manual or two system events.
jorge: attaching reconciliation snippet and portal screenshot (helio-dup-promo.png). billed to billing@helioworks.ai. Looks like both the automated YEAREND2026 and a manual "acct-level" promo were present.
billing-bot: Alert: Invoice INV-2026-1921 flagged promo_reapply during batch_job_yrend. Case ID BILL-2026-2217. Invoice status: ON_HOLD.
kevin: Approve manual one-time credit of $980 as goodwill. Charge GL 6501 (Sales Discounts). Tag notes: project=yrend-pricing-exp, root_cause=batch_job_reapply. Proceed to post today.
emily-cs: CS confirmed customer appreciates the quick fix and asked if we can expedite the refund — they have month-end close. Any way to priority-post?
maria: We'll mark the journal for priority posting in tonight's ad-hoc batch. Journal template: Debit Sales Discounts (GL 6501) $980 / Credit Accounts Receivable $980. Memo: "Manual credit per KEVIN approval; case BILL-2026-2217; priority post"
jorge: Posted and attached txn id: RFND-20261230-441. Invoice internal note updated. Also added link to ticket: https://billing.redwood.internal/tickets/BILL-2026-2217
billing-bot: Case BILL-2026-2217 closed by user jorge at 2026-12-30T20:17:45Z.
rachel: Thanks — I'll confirm with CS and send the customer note. Also looped in @product about batch job guardrails (EXP-YEAREND-02).
kevin: Good catch everyone. Please include the experiment id in the monthly reconciliation pack for audit.
emily-cs: Customer replied: "Thanks — refund received and appreciated." Closing from CS side. :white_check_mark:
